svg.text: NEMOS_MeshAnalysis.py — inspect the mesh OpenFOAM actually solved on
Reads the converted mesh from the case folder with PyVista and reports cell quality and near-wall growth rate. Run it from its own script.
this module's own copy; same idea as in the simulation
every image is a slice through 'xy', 'xz' or 'yz' at value (default: mid-plane)
one row per cell: id, value, x, y, z, type
Two places to check mesh quality — they are not the same check
while meshing: run() stage 2, from your run script
afterwards, from a separate analysis script
the OpenFOAM mesh the solver used
